findings.title: New demo toast copy breaks the sibling pattern established in the same file
findings.evidence: +pub const demo_bulk_invite_toast: String = "Demo mode - invites are not sent." (siblings: demo_payments_toast "Payments aren't part of the demo. Create your own vacancy to unlock AI analysis." / demo_settings_profile_toast "Settings aren't part of the demo. Sign up to manage your real profile.")
findings.detail: Verified: siblings read "X aren't part of the demo. <next action>"; new copy uses a "Demo mode -" prefix, uncontracted "are not", no next action. Counterweight: phrasing faithfully renders the user's verbatim ruling ("it should just say this is demo, not sent") and the PR documents the decision; hyphen over em-dash is correct per the #607/#612 toast em-dash ban (copy.gleam header: "sentence breaks, never em-dashes").
findings.recommended_fix: Optional voice polish only — e.g. contraction. Ruling phrasing wins if kept as-is.

findings.title: Empty-emails demo arm untested (user-facing claim corrected: button is disabled when empty)

findings.detail: Reviewer's headline claim (user clicks send on empty textarea and gets nothing) is FALSE — the send button is disabled when the textarea is empty (has_emails && !is_loading gate). Verified kernel: the empty arm itself has no test; it is stray-dispatch defense exactly mirroring the real handler's empty no-op (client.gleam "" -> #(model, effect.none())).
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: one-line test dispatching UserSubmittedBulkInvite with empty emails asserting no toast + no effect.
findings.verification: confirmed (kernel; headline user-facing claim rejected as false-positive)

findings.title: Real-mode in-flight ApiReturnedBulkInvite response can render the send-shaped toast after entering demo mode
findings.evidence: demo_update.gleam:654: `_ -> fallback(model, msg)` ("Everything else (response messages ...) falls through to the real handler"); client.gleam:266-267 True -> demo_update.handle(...); client.gleam:2252 ApiReturnedBulkInvite(result) ->; enter_demo resets loading_action: None but cannot cancel in-flight HTTP effects.
findings.detail: Verified mechanically: a real-mode send whose response lands after /demo entry routes through demo_update's fallback to the real handler, rendering a send-shaped toast in demo. Pre-existing systemic fall-through (same window for every real-mode response message, incl. the other two NEVER_PRODUCED entries); sub-second navigation race; the send itself happened in real mode, so the ruling's no-demo-send holds. The new lint comment's absolute claim ("the demo never renders a send-shaped result") is broader than what the lint proves (no demo-originated producer).
findings.recommended_fix: Either intercept ApiReturnedBulkInvite in demo_update.handle (consume silently) or scope the lint comment/PR claim to demo-originated producers.
